lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical high-contrast lines; spacing is progressively wider from the posterior (narrowest) to the mid-torso (widest) before narrowing again at the shoulder.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the most anterior line near the upper scapula region where the line splits into a Y-shape toward the dorsal crest.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Shortened line segments observed on the 10th and 11th anterior lines; several lines on the lower mid-torso are interrupted by white spot intersections.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6-8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior flank, concentrated between the 2nd and 6th vertical lines.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots align in a horizontal geometric vector along the lower mid-flank.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with an initial lateral-posterior vector from the pedicle, spiraling medially with tips oriented inward.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated 1.75:1 ratio between the inter-tip distance and the horizontal width of the horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: 0.12 proportional length of ivory-white tipping relative to the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white dorsal crest/mane spanning from the neck to the tail; white distal limb markings (socks) extending from the hooves to the mid-radius/tibia.
